terms.gloss: make mild, soft, or ripe; tame; soothe, calm
evidence: Cic. ND 2.130: Indus agrōs laetificat et mītigat (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: make soft or supple; make milder, tame
evidence: Cic. ND 2.26: frīgoribus dūrēscit ūmor, et īdem vicissim mollītur tepefactus (Lewis & Short)
Hor. S. 1.4.20: dum ferrum molliat ignis (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: make mild, soften, soothe, calm, relieve
evidence: Plin. NH 20.96: alvum lēnit et mollit (Lewis & Short)

phrases.english: the Indus gladdens the fields and makes them mellow

phrases.latin: dextera pistillō prīmum frāglantia mollit ālia, tum pariter mixtō terit omnia sūcō
phrases.english: his right hand first softens the strong-smelling garlic with the pestle, then grinds everything together with the juice mixed in

phrases.latin: cum sale pānis lātrantem stomachum bene lēniet
phrases.english: bread with salt will quiet a growling stomach well enough

phrases.latin: Nīl nōn aut lēnit aut domat diūturnitās.
phrases.english: There is nothing that length of time does not soften or tame.

sources: Lewis & Short: lenio
